name: samba-guest-share
description: Practice-box misconfiguration: installs Samba (if needed) and adds a guest-writable (unauthenticated) share. Paired check wants no 'guest ok = yes' share. Vars: SHARE_NAME (optional, default relay-public); SHARE_PATH (optional, default /srv/relay-public).
script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
[ -e /etc/samba/smb.conf ] || { apt-get update -y >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; apt-get install -y samba >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }
share="${SHARE_NAME:-relay-public}"
path="${SHARE_PATH:-/srv/relay-public}"
install -d -m 0777 "$path"
f=/etc/samba/smb.conf
if ! grep -q "^\[$share\]" "$f" 2>/dev/null; then
  {
    printf '\n[%s]\n' "$share"
    printf '   path = %s\n' "$path"
    printf '   browseable = yes\n'
    printf '   read only = no\n'
    printf '   guest ok = yes\n'
  } >> "$f"
fi
systemctl restart smbd >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
